chat: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me exactly where on your wrist the pain is located, and could you describe the appearance of the skin lesions in more detail? Also, how high is your fever and how long have these symptoms been present?

The pain is centered around my left wrist joint, and it's swollen, red, and incredibly tender to the touch. On both my hands and wrists, I have these strange, painless purple blisters that look like they contain pus. I've had the wrist pain for three days, it got much worse this morning with chills and feeling really sick, though I did have some knee pain last week that went away on its own.
